info.title: Unknown
info.description: Command line player for Return to Zork, Zork Nemesis, Zork: Grand Inquisitor and Infocom's Z-machine games: dotnet tool install -g Gue.Player, then gue <game folder or story file>.

options.name: --list
options.description: show the games found and stop

options.name: --game
options.description: run this game when there are several (rtz, znemesis, zgi, zork1-r88)

options.name: --scale
options.description: window scale (default 3, or 1 for a Z-machine game)

options.name: --headless
options.description: run without a window for TICKS ticks of 1/60 s

options.name: --screenshot
options.description: headless: write the last frame to FILE

options.name: --shots
options.description: headless: write a frame every --shot-every ticks (default 60)

options.name: --click
options.description: headless: click the left button at tick T

options.name: --key
options.description: headless: press KEY (F2, Escape, Return, or a character) at tick T

options.name: --wav
options.description: headless: record the game's audio to FILE

options.name: --commands
options.description: a Z-machine game: type the commands in FILE, one a line

options.name: --transcript
options.description: headless, a Z-machine game: no screen, its text to FILE (- for the console)

options.name: --saves
options.description: keep saves in FOLDER (default: the user's GUE save folder)

options.name: --mt32-roms
options.description: play the music on the MT-32 emulator with the ROMs in FOLDER

options.name: --mt32-model
options.description: cm32l or mt32 when FOLDER has both (default: CM-32L, as ScummVM)
